from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancingCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Financing cash flow figures from one company's 10-Q filing for comparative analysis."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as stated in the filing")
    period_label: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period label (e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2024')")
    current_period_financing_cash_flow: float | None = Field(description="Net cash from financing activities for current period (positive = provided, negative = used)")
    current_period_label: str | None = Field(description="How the current period amount is labeled in the document")
    prior_period_financing_cash_flow: float | None = Field(description="Net cash from financing activities for comparable prior period")
    prior_period_label: str | None = Field(description="How the prior period amount is labeled in the document")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How amounts are expressed in the document: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions', etc.")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the financing cash flow figures")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financing_cash_flows: list[CompanyFinancingCashFlow]
